note: Median of three consecutive release-profile runs on one machine, taken in a quiet window with other applications closed. Measurement p95 is 3,619 ms against a 3,500 ms target: the target is missed by 3.4% and is recorded as missed. The 6.7% rise over the superseded baseline is not a code regression - the code is roughly 46% faster than the code that baseline was committed with, measured by running commit eada7c8 on this machine against the same bundle, ORT 1.28.0 and thread settings (p95 6,684 ms against today's 3,619 ms; eada7c8 reconfigured both tokenizers inside every encode call, fixed in 501d62f). The rise is environmental: preflight loads no model and rose 73% over the same period, which no measurement-code change can cause. The superseded baseline no longer reproduces from its own commit on this machine.
